event_chain.summary: Portal documents for 500+ films posted on Internet Archive - cause not established

summary: Documents relating to more than 500 films submitted between December 2025 and August 2026 to India's Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) through its e-Cinepramaan certification portal - shooting scripts, CBFC cut orders and distribution agreements revealing licensing fees - were posted to the Internet Archive by an account using the name of former CBFC chairman Prasoon Joshi written in Russian, and stayed downloadable until the account was taken down on October 12, 2026. The Hindu reported the leak in late October. CBFC said it found no evidence of external attack or unauthorised access to filmmaker accounts, filed a cybercrime complaint, informed CERT-In and began a security audit; how the documents were obtained is unknown.
